# fptcloud_backup_veeam_restore_points (Data Source)

Lists the restore points of one protected instance - the same table the portal shows when you pick "Restore" on an instance. Use it to choose the `restore_point_id` for a `fptcloud_backup_veeam_restore`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_vpc" "this" {
  name = "your_vpc_name"
}

# The restore points of one protected instance - the same table the portal shows
# when you pick "Restore" on an instance. Points are ordered newest first, so
# points[0] is the most recent backup.
data "fptcloud_backup_veeam_restore_points" "db" {
  vpc_id        = data.fptcloud_vpc.this.id
  backup_job_id = "your_backup_job_id"
  vm_id         = "your_instance_id"
}

# Only full restore points, if an incremental one will not do.
data "fptcloud_backup_veeam_restore_points" "db_full" {
  vpc_id        = data.fptcloud_vpc.this.id
  backup_job_id = "your_backup_job_id"
  vm_id         = "your_instance_id"
  point_type    = "full"
}

output "latest_restore_point" {
  value = data.fptcloud_backup_veeam_restore_points.db.points[0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_job_id` (String) The ID of the backup job that produced the restore points.
- `vm_id` (String) The ID of the protected instance.
- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC.

### Optional

- `point_type` (String) Only return restore points of this kind: `full` or `incremental`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `points` (List of Object) The restore points, newest first - the same order and the same columns the portal's restore dialog shows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--points))

<a id="nestedatt--points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `points`

Read-Only:

- `backup_file_size` (Number)
- `id` (String)
- `point_type` (String)
- `restore_at` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `vm_display_name` (String)
